title: SDLC Task Identifier v1
description: A canonical task identity composed of a WorkItemId, a hyphen separator, and an eight-digit task-tree order key.
$comment: TaskIdentifier has the canonical form {WorkItemId}-{OrderKey}. For example, WI-0003-05000000 identifies task-tree position 05000000 in WI-0003. Pipe-separated identifiers are migration-only inputs and are not canonical task identifiers.
